verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street publishes a dedicated guide to handling a USCIS Request for Evidence, framing an RFE as 'an opportunity to strengthen your case.' Its products page promises support 'from start to approval,' which implies help continues past the first filing. However, the evidence is educational content plus an RFE-prevention claim ('minimize RFEs'), not an explicit statement that RFE response is an included service. NOIDs are never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit RFE-response service scope or pricing, any NOID coverage, client or independent corroboration of RFE response outcomes.
